fixes.explanation: Paul says the faithful men will be "…qualified to teach others as well." Look at that chain, friend. Paul to Timothy, Timothy to faithful men, faithful men to others. Teaching is the job the verse gives them.
That's right, friend. Paul says, "The hardworking farmer should be the first to partake of the crops." First in line, not last. The farmer did the work, so he's the one who should partake first.

That's right, friend. Paul writes, "Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David, as proclaimed by my gospel…" Raised from the dead is right there in the verse. It's part of what Timothy is told to remember, and Paul says it's proclaimed by his gospel.
